subject.title: [Bug/Docs]: local+hybrid memory_search quality can appear unstable due to extraPaths path drift + benchmark-file contamination

question: Should this stay open as the umbrella for memory-search path hygiene, diagnostics, and exclusion semantics, with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95739 handling only the exclusion slice?
rationale: The remaining work adds or documents public memorySearch configuration and backend behavior, and the right QMD/builtin parity boundary is a maintainer product decision rather than a narrow bug repair.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Keep this issue open until the exclusion PR, docs, diagnostics, and QMD/backend scope decisions are resolved or explicitly split.

options.title: Narrow to the open PR
options.body: Treat the configurable exclusion part as owned by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95739 and split the docs/diagnostics remainder into smaller follow-ups.

options.title: Fold into broader scope design
options.body: Supersede this issue with the broader recall/index eligibility design at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101422 if maintainers want one product surface.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the exclusion PR, docs, diagnostics, and QMD/backend scope decisions are resolved or explicitly split.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across memory-core internals, memory-host extraction, and public memory docs/config surfaces.
